description: Cortex plugin hooks — session recording and memory injection

hooks.prompt:
Before ending this session, produce a session report for the cortex vault. Review what was accomplished in this session and create a report with these sections:

## Commits
List all git commits made in this session with their subjects, repos, and issue refs.

## Discoveries
Any technical insights, root causes found, or important observations.

## Decisions
Architecture or design decisions made and their reasoning.

## Other
Helping colleagues, code reviews, support tickets, anything else notable.

## Unfinished
Work in progress or things left to do.

If the session was trivial (just a question, no real work done), return 'approve' to stop without saving.

Otherwise, present the report to the user and ask for confirmation. If confirmed:
1. Read ~/.cortex/config.json to get vault_path
2. Write the report to <vault_path>/Raw/YYYY/MM/DD/HHMMSS_session_<repo>.md with frontmatter (date, time, type: session, repo, tags)
3. git add and commit in the vault repo

If the user says skip, return 'approve' to stop without saving.
If the user confirms, save then return 'approve'.
